representativeSnapshot.kind: isolated production-like Supabase branch with ticket_sales, ticket_types, tickets, transfers, and checkins

rowCountQueries: ticket_sales, ticket_types, tickets, ticket_credentials, ticket_transfers, ticket_checkins grouped by event/org
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Additive create-table/index/policy/function replacement; zero existing rows backfilled

execution.resumeStrategy: Transactional additive DDL and CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION; rerun migration safely after interruption
execution.idempotency: Tables use IF NOT EXISTS, indexes use IF NOT EXISTS, functions are CREATE OR REPLACE, and runtime ledger rows use idempotency keys

quarantine.strategy: No tenant-key guessing or backfill is performed; rows missing org_id remain visible only through event-scoped policy checks

constraints: ticket_transfers one pending transfer per ticket partial unique index
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Validate creation, grants, RLS policies, function signatures, and two-org isolation before staging promotion

recovery.rollback: Do not delete ticketing data automatically; disable new app reads/writes and ship a reviewed forward migration that removes or ignores new tables if needed
recovery.forwardFix: Use additive follow-up migrations for policy, function, or index corrections while preserving ledger and provider inbox history
